title: FGC 635: Gaseous Hydrogen Systems
officialText:
635.1 Installation.

The installation of gaseous hydrogen systems shall be in accordance with the applicable requirements of the New York City Fire Code, the New York City Building Code, and Chapter 7 of this code.
